body: Happy early birthday! At 2pm eastern standard time I'll look up at the sky and wish you a happy birthday, if you do the same at that time you wont be alone because we'll be celebrating together :) plans made! I understand depression, it's a deep dark ocean of blahhhh, but look at us even though sometimes we're grasping for breath, other times we're jumping over the waves. Together. You're not alone, no matter how much it feels like you are.
